title: The expression time environment
teaches: A :expr track is evaluated every frame with t, tick, beat, bar, phase, cycle, bpm and dur bound. The bindings are numbers; a vector expression is allowed when its length matches the target's arity.
observe: tick counts PPC ticks per bar, so 0.5 s at 120 bpm is 180180.
grid packs beat, bar and phase into one vec3 target.
rate is bpm times dur in beats, a constant 960.
seconds is the same clock the host passed in.
